Wild Heart's Return is a Companion Story of Lingyang that takes place in Jinzhou, Huanglong.

Contents

  • 1 Summary

  • 3 Gameplay Notes
  • 4 Dialogue
  • 5 Video Guides
  • 6 Other Languages
  • 7 Change History

Summary[]

You run into Lingyang chatting with some children. He introduces you to the Liondance Troupe and tells you about some of Jinzhou's traditions. He asks you to accompany him in preparing for the upcoming Liondance—and also offers to grab a bite en route.
After talking with the client, Lingyang agrees to celebrate an elderly person's birthday during tomorrow's performance.
After talking with the second clients, Lingyang agrees to include the "Liondance Officiant" ceremony in tomorrow's performance to celebrate their wedding.
Lingyang treats you to some local Jinzhou specialties at a food stall, suggesting the stall owner—one of his clients—offer snacks during the performance as a way to advertise. However, the owner explains they are short on ingredients due to the disruption caused by a creature known as the "Jingle Beast" and a gang called "The Savages." Hearing this, Lingyang appears deep in thought.
Lingyang heads to a teahouse to take care of an unresolved request. The stall owner expresses concern about Lingyang's tendency to prioritize others over himself and asks if you can check on him. You agree to help.
At the teahouse, you find Lingyang discussing a mysterious request with Bei Shi. They suspect the request came from Bei Shi's brother, Bei Ji, who has been missing for a week and may be involved with "The Savages." To find out more, you and Bei Shi start investigating Bei Ji's packages.
A courier tells you that locals have been paying "The Savages" to fend off the "Jingle Beast." With this clue, you head to the area where the beast is often spotted.
Near an Exile's camp, you overhear that "The Savages" are exploiting the "Jingle Beast" legend. You also learn that a new member has joined their ranks hoping to find the Beast.
Everything points to "The Savages" spreading rumors about the "Jingle Beast" and selling spoiled ingredients. You discover the new recruit is Bei Ji. To keep you safe, Lingyang volunteers to investigate "the Savages" himself while you and Bei Shi focus on finding Bei Ji.
Bei Shi shares that Bei Ji has been feeling guilty about her. She also opens up about her fear of the "Jingle Beast," which stems from a past encounter out in the wild.
Lingyang tells you that "The Savages" have taken Bei Ji to a cave. Sensing danger, he suggests you join him in the rescue while Bei Shi alerts the Patrollers.
When you reach the cave, Bei Ji faces "The Savages" with resolve, determined to bring them to justice before you and Lingyang arrive to help.
Defeating "The Savages" causes a commotion that awakens three Spearbacks in the cave. To protect you, Lingyang steps in to take on them.
Lingyang asks you to keep his beastly side a secret. After hearing about your efforts, Bei Ji opens up about his conflict with Bei Shi, sharing his true feelings.
With the Patrollers' help, you catch "The Savages" and the Bei siblings are finally reunited.
You learn that Bei Ji had originally planned to kill the "Jingle Beast" to prove his courage and earn his sister's respect. Though he feels like he has failed, Lingyang reminds him that true bravery lies in overcoming one's weaknesses for those we care about. Bei Ji gains Bei Shi's understanding, but her fear of the "Jingle Beast" remains. To help her, Lingyang invites the siblings to watch the Liondance, believing it may help dispel Bei Shi's fear.
Lingyang asks you to check backstage for props that might help Bei Shi form a new opinion about the "Jingle Beast."
Before the performance, Lingyang shares the origin and meaning of the Liondance, suggesting that it might help Bei Shi overcome her fear of the "Jingle Beast."
You meet with various clients before the performance. The Bei siblings are curious about the secret of the "Jingle Beast," while Grandpa Gan reminisces about the Liondance performances he enjoyed during his time in the army. Linling and Shengmao decide to give the "Settlement" ceremony another go, and everyone awaits the grand Liondance with excitement.
Thanks to the Liondance performance, Bei Shi can recall how the sound of a bell saved her during a previous attack in the wild. Her fears begin to shift as her courage is restored.
In the end, Lingyang reveals the truth about the "Jingle Beast"—it is the last "Suan'ni." Moved by humanity's bravery against the Lament, this creature longed to become one of them. It had been trying to understand what it means to be human and ultimately discovered that the answer lies in the "heart." Since that day, it has sought to express the beauty it sees in humans in its own unique way.

Steps[]

  1. Head to the theater
  2. Visit the first client with Lingyang
  3. Visit the second client with Lingyang
  4. Visit the third client with Lingyang
  5. Look for Lingyang around the teahouse
  6. Talk with Lingyang and get ready to leave
  7. Go to the logistics station ahead
  8. Go in the direction of the cry for help
  9. Rescue the logistics guy
  10. Talk to the logistics person
  11. Follow Lingyang's tips to find suspicious camps
  12. Find a suitable location and eavesdrop on The Savage Beasts' conversations
  13. Eavesdrop on The Savages' conversations
  14. Investigate the camp of "The Savages"
  15. Talk to Lingyang and Bei Shi
  16. Go in the direction of the bell
  17. Talk to Lingyang
  18. Enter the cave
    1. Get into the cavern
    2. Investigate the traces
    3. Go deeper into the caverns
    4. Defeat all enemies
    5. Investigate further
    6. Switch to Lingyang to break the rocks
    7. Explore the underworld
    8. Use Plunging Attack to break the rocks
    9. Continue exploring the underworld
    10. Use Plunging Attack to break the rocks
    11. Find the Noctemint
    12. Defeat the monsters
    13. Return to the Spearback
    14. Lure the Spearback away
    15. Head to the target location
    16. Defeat The Savage Beasts
    17. Fend off the enemies
    18. Leave "Hidden Cave"
  19. Back to the residential area
  20. Go to the theater with Lingyang
  21. Look for the right props at the theater backstage
  22. Go to the theatre the next afternoon (15:00-17:00)
  23. Look for Bei'ji and Bei'shi in the audience area
  24. Go to the backstage of the theater and look for Lingyang
  25. Follow Lingyang

Gameplay Notes[]

  • Locating the source of the bell awards the Moments with You trophy: Jingle Bells.
  • Completing this quest awards the Moments with You throphy: Rising Suan'ni

Dialogue[]

Quest Description
In Jinzhou, you meet an unusual... human?
(Head to the theater)
Little Girl: They... They say you have claws...
Little Girl: We heard you can tear those monsters into shreds...
???: Wanna take a look?
Little Boy: Yes! Please!
???: Okay, then! Here you go...
Little Girl: Eek...
Little Boy: C-Candies!
???: Try some! I hope these candies can make up for not showing you my impressive claws.
Little Boy: See? He's not scary at all!
Little Girl: Thank you, L-Lingyang!
???: You're welcome! Do come by to see our liondance show tomorrow!
Little Girl: I will!
Little Boy: See you soon!
???: Hmm... you smell unfamiliar, yet so powerful, and so pure...
Do I smell funny...?
Are you talking to me?
???: You must be that famous Rover.
???: Hiya! I've heard a lot about you, and now I finally get to meet you in person.
Lingyang: You can call me Lingyang, glad to make your acquaintance! Fare thee well, blessings swell!
I'm (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍). (Reach out your hand)
Lingyang: You really are different from everyone else...
Lingyang: So we've shaken hands. Now we're good friends!
What are you doing here?
I'm (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍). (Don't reach out your hand)
Lingyang: Hmm... So even you are scared of me, too...
Lingyang: ...Anyway! Welcome to the city of Jinzhou!
What are you doing here?
Lingyang: Our troupe is doing a big liondancing show tomorrow evening, and I'm now doing some advertising!
Your troupe?
Lingyang: Yeah, the Liondance Troupe. We do cool liondancing shows for parades.
Lingyang: Oh, and liondancingTaiping Musical is a traditional thing in Jinzhou.
A liondance show?
Lingyang: Well, liondancingTaiping Musical is a traditional thing in Jinzhou.
Lingyang: We've got whole groups dedicated to liondancing, our troupe for example.
Lingyang: We've got lots of activites in Jinzhou. I can't wait to show you!
Lingyang: (his stomach growled...)
Lingyang: Oh! Oops, uh.. Sorry, I guess I'm a bit hungry after rehearsing for a whole day.
Lingyang: Speaking of that, I should treat you to dinner! Let's talk over food. That will be fun!
That's a thing in Jinzhou too?
Lingyang: Well actually... Yes it is! Jinzhou people love feeding our guests! It's our way of showing hospitality.
Lingyang: Get ready to be blown away by the amazing flavors here!
You seem a bit too kind...
Lingyang: Don't get me wrong, but this is just how we treat our guests here in Jinzhou.
Lingyang: You'll love the hospitality here, I promise!
What do you want from me?
Lingyang: N-Nothing! Please believe me. I'm just trying to treat you to a meal, since you're our super important guest and all.
Lingyang: You'll see how we roll with our guests soon enough!
Lingyang: But right now, I still have some other things to finish...
Lingyang: I've been getting a ton of requests for private liondances lately, and some happen to overlap with our big show tomorrow.
Lingyang: And you know how important liondancing is to the folks here in Jinzhou! Can't just turn 'em down.
Lingyang: So I had an idea: why not combine all these personal requests into the grand performance? That way, everyone's happy.
Lingyang: We can even customize the performances to cater to each client's needs.
Lingyang: But first, gotta figure out exactly what our clients want!
Lingyang: (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍), wanna come with me?
Lingyang: We can go visit my clients on our way to grab food. I'll show you around and introduce you to our local customs firsthand.
Lingyang: It'll be way cooler than just hearing about it from others. What do you say?
Nice, I'm in.
Since it's your treat...
Lingyang: Great! Let's goooo!!
Lingyang: Okay, let me think.. My first client's nearby. You might've seen them before.
Lingyang: Just cross the bridge, keep going, and we're there!
(Talk to Ganxue)
Ganxue: Oh, you are...
Lingyang: Fivefold blessings grace your door, good luck and fortune evermore!
Ganxue: Aww, the Lucky Greetings... You're from the Liondance Troupe, I bet. Nice to meet you!
Ganxue: Are you here for my grandpa's birthday party?
Ganxue: I thought our reservation was tomorrow. Did you maybe mix up the time?
Lingyang: Ah, here's the thing. People from City Hall already booked a liondance show on the same day for soldiers leaving on an expedition.
Ganxue: I see...
Lingyang: But maybe we can combine your celebrations with this existing show...
Ganxue: My grandpa loves hanging out with people. He'd be so happy if you could do that for him.
Lingyang: Nice! Just double-checking again: It will be your grandfather's sixtieth birthday, right?
Ganxue: Correct.
Lingyang: Alright, I'll keep that in mind.
Lingyang: Then, I'll do six spins in a row as part of the celebration, which symbolize the six decades your grandpa has lived through!
What do you mean?
Lingyang: Means I'll dance around our birthday star on the poles! It's a special birthday celebration dance.
Lingyang: One spin for a decade past, health and vigor forever last!
Ganxue: Thank you so much. I'm sure grandpa will be happy to hear that!
Lingyang: Done! Now, onto the next client... Hmm, I remember it's a young couple.
(Optional - Talk to Ganxue again)
About liondance...
Ganxue: Ah, so you want to learn more about liondancing?
Ganxue: Well, I don't know much about it, but my grandpa has always been an invested fan.
Ganxue: He's even friends with Mr. Wufang and Mr. Qixing, who are sorta like advisors to the troupe. They often hang out at Liuxian Teahouse and chat over tea.
Ganxue: Fun fact: those aren't their real names, just special titles that have been passed down over the generations.
Ganxue: But everyone knows them by these names now.
Ganxue: Nowadays, they prefer to stay behind the scenes and provide instructions, rather than be in the spotlight themselves.
Ganxue: If you wanna get to know them better, you might just need some good luck.
(Talk to Linling)
Lingyang: Blissful union, endless delight, love eternal in thee alight!
Linling: Oh my, look who's here! Come here, Lingyang!
Linling: We're getting the wedding candies ready. Here's one for you, and this one here...
Blissful union, endless delight, love eternal in thee alight!
Thank you.
Lingyang: Thank you for the candies! Actually, I'm here for that liondance request you made...
Lingyang: City Hall already booked a show for soldiers on the same day, so...
Linling: Really? So you won't be able to perform for us?
Linling: We are both born and raised in Huanglong, so we've been super looking forward to the "Liondance Officiant" ceremony during our wedding...
Is there anything special about this ceremony?
Lingyang: It's an interactive wedding ceremony.
Lingyang: The bride and groom stand on either side of the liondance performer. When the lion head opens its mouth, they put their hands inside and it bites down.
Lingyang: It's called "Settlement". It symbolizes an unbreakable bond!
Lingyang: I know this wedding means everything to you, and I don't want you to have any regrets.
Lingyang: Your love is rock solid, and I can see that. The "Liondance Officiant" ceremony would just be the cherry on top of your unbreakable bond.
Lingyang: How about you two exchanging tokens when the lion head reaches the top during tomorrow's performance? It'll be a lively atmosphere with drums, gongs, and firecrackers bursting in celebration...
Lingyang: Even though it's not exactly the thing you wanted, isn't it still a unique way to exchange vows in front of your loved ones?
Lingyang: And it symbolizes... "To the world's end your hearts aligned, to the sky's edge your fates entwined!"
Linling: Aw, that's so sweet.
Linling: My partner's a soldier in training, headed to defend our borders soon. The liondance show for departing soldiers must mean a lot to him.
Linling: Sheng, what do you say?
Shengmao: Sure, I'm happy to go along with whatever you want.
Linling: Okay. Hmm, we'll need some more time to think it through.
Lingyang: No problem, I'll be waiting to hear from you!
Lingyang: Alright! Just one more client to go! He's at the place where we'll be eating our dinner!
Lingyang: Uhh... My stomach's rumbling again. Can't wait for a big feast!
(Optional - Talk to Linling again)
Linling: Hello, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍), what can I do for you?
About liondance...
Shengmao: Oh! I know!
Shengmao: The soldiers of Jinzhou have a special affection for liondance. It originated from the ancient celebration of Taiping Musical, symbolizing success and a positive beginning.
Shengmao: The Liondance Troupe often travels to boost soldier morale, performing at frontlines and military camps.
Shengmao: Liondance mixes boxing with dance, drawing from Huanglong's traditional martial arts for its moves.
Shengmao: There's a folk belief that the liondance's footwork, known as the "Bugang Steps," originated from an ancient ritual that could exorcise evil spirits...
Shengmao: "Tread on the Dipper's stars, and no evil shall escape"... This is one of the reasons why people believe liondance can ward off evil and bring good luck.
Shengmao: When we see the Liondance Troupe, we all hurry to watch. Not just for good luck, but to pick up some combat moves too.
(Visit Shuncai)
Lingyang: Here we are. This is the place!
Lingyang: Heya, mister! Lionpeppers on the beam, may your profits always stream!
Shuncai: Oh hi! Isn't that the Lingyang boy?
Shuncai: What brought you here? My liondance request? I heard you're getting a ton of requests. I hope you can still fit mine in.
Shuncai: Look, I got the Lionpepper and everything. Just waiting for you to put on the lion head and chow down at my store opening!
Lingyang: Sir, there's something I need to tell you...
Shuncai: Yeah, I heard. My thing conflicts with the performance you're doing for the soldiers, right? Will you have to cancel?
Lingyang: Exactly. So I was thinking we could incorporate some "Lionpepper" elements into the show to make up for it...
Shuncai: Nah, no need to worry about my little shop, boyo. Just focus on your big performance!
Shuncai: Oh, and you must be...
Call me Rover.
I'm (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍).
Shuncai: Haha, looks like Lingyang has made a new friend.
Shuncai: Here, try this while you're here! A new snack I just came up with!
Lingyang: Go on, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍). Dinner's on me. Mr. Shuncai is a great chef!
Lingyang: To really get to know a city, start with the food!
Don't mind if I do.
Lingyang: Yum-yum! Hey sir, can we share this snack with the audience during our evening show? No snacks, no show!
Lingyang: Let me do something for you. Anything! To help you attract more customers.
Shuncai: Oh my, that'll be my great honor!
Shuncai: But...
Lingyang: What's the matter?
Shuncai: Have you heard? There's a monster in the wild recently, one they call the Jingle Beast...
Lingyang: The Jingle Beast...
Shuncai: Yeah. Somehow the nickname sounds cute even!
Shuncai: But you know what? It does all the terrible stuff you can think of!
Shuncai: When hunting, it makes these jingling sounds... They say its tusks are over half a meter long and its claws shred prey with ease.
It sounds scary.
Interesting.
Lingyang: No, that's not true. The "Jingle Beast" doesn't look like that...
Do you know it?
Lingyang: It... It's a... A friend of mine.
Shuncai: Well, actually... I need this one ingredient for my new snack, but the Jingle Beast has been messing things up. Can't find good meat anywhere right now.
Lingyang: Do you have other ways to replenish your stock?
Shuncai: There's only one place left to get it, and it's run by this Exile group called "The Savages".
Shuncai: Apparently, they're in cahoots with the Jingle Beast, and that's how they still have meat for sale.
Shuncai: But it's crazy expensive—five times the usual price! It's insane!
Shuncai: I'm just a small shop, how am I supposed to afford that?
Shuncai: So... I can't make a lot of these snacks for you to hand out yet.
Are you okay?
Lingyang: Me? Oh... I'm fine...
Lingyang: It suddenly struck me that there was another request to deal with... It should be right next to the tea house not far away. Now, if you'll excuse me, I must go!
Lingyang: Sorry, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍). I'll be back soon!
Shuncai: Oh, that's typical Lingyang.
Well, that was sudden...
Before I could say anything, he's gone...
Shuncai: You'll get used to him soon.
Shuncai: He's spontaneous, always doing whatever pops into his head at the moment.
Shuncai: He just loves helping people.
Shuncai: You'll often see him sprinting around the alleys, lending a hand wherever needed.
Shuncai: He's quick and strong, nothing seems to faze him. He's been such a blessing to us.
Shuncai: We do feel bad when he injures himself accidentally, though... He brushes it off and tells us not to fret, but even though he says not to worry, we still do.
Shuncai: (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍), can you go check on him? Whatever you order at my place will be on the house!
Sure, I'll go.
Shuncai: Thank you!
Let me finish my food first.
Shuncai: Of course, take your time.
Shuncai: The teahouse Lingyang mentioned is in the residential area, just past the square. Keep walking and you'll find it...
(Look for Lingyang)
Bei Shi: Sorry, but I'm not the one you're looking for. I never made any liondancing requests...
Lingyang: (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍), what brought you here?
I was worried.
Lingyang: It's not a big deal, really! Thanks for coming to check on me.
Are you in trouble?
You didn't pay enough for the meal.
Lingyang: What? Oh no! How much money did it cost you? I'll pay you back!
I'm just kidding.
Lingyang: I was really freaked out for a moment. If anyone finds out I let the guest pay, I'll be shamed in Jinzhou!
Are you in trouble?
Lingyang: I received a strange request from the Bei Family. It didn't mention any specific requirements.
Lingyang: Could it be your parents?
Bei Shi: ...No, it can't be. Now, if there's nothing else, please excuse me.
Lingyang: Please, one moment! Bei Shi... do you have an older brother?
Bei Shi: How did you know...
Lingyang: The client who called me had a mature male voice.
Lingyang: And since he said he's from the Bei Family, there is only one other possibility...
Lingyang: Bei Shi, has something happened to you?
Bei Shi: ...
Lingyang: I'm Lingyang from the Liondance Troupe. This is (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍).
Lingyang: You can trust us.
Bei Shi: ...It's about my brother, Bei Ji. It's been a week now, and he still hasn't come back home.
Lingyang: A week ago... That's when I received this request.
Lingyang: Was he acting strange the last time you saw him?
Bei Shi: My brother and I stopped talking to each other a while back, after a big fight. I don't even know when he last left our house...
Bei Shi: But... he still sends me packages from time to time. It's been a bunch of strange stuff...
Lingyang: This package has old Angelica flowers, they don't smell good anymore.
Lingyang: And these meats... They are almost bad, even though they're refrigerated... Anything else he told you?
Bei Shi: He mentioned hanging out with people from The Savages in one of his letters...
Why didn't you inform the Patrollers?
Bei Shi: I didn't tell anyone, because I was worried my brother would get in trouble if I reported it to the police.
Lingyang: Yeah, The Savages seem shady. And there's talk of the Jingle Beast being connected to them.
Lingyang: But the return addresses on these packages are all different. How are we supposed to find him?
We can go ask the package delivery people.
Lingyang: I see... (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍), you're so clever!
Lingyang: Bei Shi, leave it to me! I'll help you find your brother.
Bei Shi: Can I go with you?
Lingyang: I get it, Bei Shi. You really want to find your brother.
Lingyang: But it's dangerous out there with the TD Outbreaks happening more frequently. I can't guarantee your safety if we run into a spreading Tacet Field.
Bei Shi: I... I can handle it. I used to be a member of the Pioneer Association, too.
Bei Shi: Us Pioneers never... never back down from a challenge...
You don't sound so confident.
Don't bite off more than you can chew.
Bei Shi: But... I...
Lingyang: If you insist... Okay, but we'll need to ask (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍) about it.
Lingyang: (‍‍HeText for male Rover‍/‍SheText for female Rover‍‍) is a strong Resonator. With (‍‍himText for male Rover‍/‍herText for female Rover‍‍), we'll be safer on our journey.
Lingyang: To be honest, I don't want to drag my friend into this... But this is an emergency, and Bei Shi want to tag along, so I'm asking a favor of you.
Bei Shi: (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍), I know it's a big ask...
Bei Shi: But please... Please help me!
I plan to.
Okay, then, since you're asking for my help...
Bei Shi: Amazing! Thank you, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍)!
Bei Shi: The guy who brings my packages is always the same dude, and I know where he works.
Lingyang: Okay, let's get this dealt with. (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍), are you ready?
Let's go.
One moment.
(Arrive at the logistics station)
Bei Shi: It should be around here...
Lingyang: Wait... There's someone calling for help...
Lingyang: Over there! The Hoochiefs are attacking someone!
After defeating the Hoochiefs)
Stern Courier: Phew... Thank you! You saved my life!
Lingyang: Are you alright?
Stern Courier: Thanks for asking. I'm fine. I could have run away, but then the packages wouldn't reach their recipients...
Your professionalism is commendable.
Stern Courier: Of course! "We Promise, We Deliver"! That's our slogan at the Lollo Logistics!
Do people often drop off their packages here?
Stern Courier: All packages must be transferred at this station, but we rarely see anyone dropping off their packages here. If someone did, I will surely remember them.
Lingyang: We're searching for a missing person who used your service. Can you help us?
Stern Courier: Sure! You just saved my life. I'll tell you everything I can remember!
Does this look familiar to you?
Stern Courier: Hmm, I'm sorry, but this doesn't ring any bell...
Lingyang: But we just checked the package tracker, and it said you were the deliveryman...
Stern Courier: ...M-Maybe it was a mistake?
Lingyang: I see... Well, we still have another question.
About the Jingle Beast...
Stern Courier: The "Twinkle Beast"? You mean that monster everyone's been talking about recently?
Lingyang: You mean the "Jingle Beast", right?
Stern Courier: Yeah, whatever. That dangerous, man-eating thing.
Stern Courier: It's said to have long tusks and sharp claws that can tear anything to shreds...
Stern Courier: And there's this Exile group, called "The Savages", and they claim to be able to talk to that beast.
Stern Courier: So people have been paying them to talk the "Jingle Beast" out of attacking humans...
About "The Savages"...
Stern Courier: "The Savages"... Yeah, sounds familiar...
Stern Courier: Do you know the "Tingle Beast"? That monster everyone's been talking about recently.
Lingyang: You mean the "Jingle Beast", right?
Stern Courier: Yeah, whatever. That dangerous, man-eating thing.
Stern Courier: It's said that they know how to communicate with that ferocious beast.
Stern Courier: So people have been paying them to talk the "Jingle Beast" out of attacking humans...
Stern Courier: That's all I know, sir.
Lingyang: Thank you, but I've got one last question.
Lingyang: Do you know where we can find The Savages, or the Jingle Beast?
Stern Courier: ...Sorry, but we have our rules to f-follow... I cannot divulge details of our clients.
Stern Courier: But I heard the Jingle Beast is often found roaming in a campsite. It's somewhere near a broken tree, on that mountainside...
Stern Courier: Those working on the guard tower can often spot it, too.
Lingyang: I see. Thank you for answering my questions.
Stern Courier: Sir, may I remind you...
Stern Courier: That thing is very dangerous... It's ferocious beyond your wildest imagination. Please be careful...
Stern Courier: And there may be more than one of them...
Lingyang: Don't worry! If there really was a second Jingle Beast... Well, I'll have to see it for myself!
The deliveryman thanked you and left...
Bei Shi: Oh well... We didn't get anything useful from him...
We did learn something.
Lingyang: Yeah. At least now we know The Savages and the Jingle Beast are definitely connected.
Lingyang: Besides, did you see his expression?
Lingyang: He seemed frightened. I bet he was hiding something from us out of fear.
He had been threatened.
He felt guilty.
Lingyang: Well, but at least we still got some clues from him. Like where we can find the Jingle Beast.
Bei Shi: B-but there are so many campsites in the wild, how can we pinpoint its exact location with a couple words from him?
